   384→    def mark_batch_ready(self, sequence_id: str) -> Optional[GateBatch]:
   385→        """Mark batch as ready for review"""
   386→        batch = self._batches.get(sequence_id)
   387→        if batch:
   388→            batch.status = "ready"
   389→
   390→            audit_log().log(
   391→                operation="batch_ready",
   392→                message=f"Batch ready for review: {batch.pending_count()} proposals",
   393→                level=AuditLevel.INFO,
   394→                category=AuditCategory.GATE,
   395→                sequence_id=sequence_id,
   396→                input_data={"batch_id": batch.batch_id, "count": len(batch.proposals)},
   397→            )
   398→
   399→            for callback in self._on_batch_ready:
   400→                try:
   401→                    callback(batch)
   402→                except Exception:
   403→                    logger.error(
   404→                        "Gate callback %s failed",
   405→                        getattr(callback, "__name__", repr(callback)),
   406→                        exc_info=True,
   407→                    )
   408→
   409→        return batch

   411→    def decide(
   412→        self,
   413→        proposal_id: str,
   414→        decision: GateDecision,
   415→        user_id: str,
   416→        notes: str = "",
   417→        modified_changes: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   418→    ) -> Optional[GateProposal]:
   419→        """
   420→        Record human decision on a proposal.
   421→
   422→        Args:
   423→            proposal_id: ID of proposal to decide
   424→            decision: The decision (APPROVED, REJECTED, MODIFIED, DEFERRED)
   425→            user_id: Who made the decision
   426→            notes: Optional notes explaining decision
   427→            modified_changes: If MODIFIED, the adjusted changes
   428→
   429→        Returns:
   430→            Updated proposal or None if not found
   431→        """
   432→        with self._write_lock:
   433→            proposal = self._proposals.get(proposal_id)
   434→            if not proposal:
   435→                return None
   436→
   437→            proposal.decision = decision
   438→            proposal.decided_by = user_id
   439→            proposal.decided_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
   440→            proposal.decision_notes = notes
   441→
   442→            if decision == GateDecision.MODIFIED and modified_changes:
   443→                proposal.modified_changes = modified_changes
   444→
   445→            # Audit log
   446→            audit_level = AuditLevel.GATE_APPROVAL if decision in (
   447→                GateDecision.APPROVED, GateDecision.MODIFIED
   448→            ) else AuditLevel.GATE_REJECTION
   449→
   450→            audit_log().log_human_decision(
   451→                operation="gate_decision",
   452→                message=f"[{decision.value.upper()}] {proposal.operation}: {notes or 'No notes'}",
   453→                user_id=user_id,
   454→                category=proposal.category,
   455→                sequence_id=proposal.sequence_id,
   456→                input_data={
   457→                    "proposal_id": proposal_id,
   458→                    "decision": decision.value,
   459→                    "original_changes": proposal.proposed_changes,
   460→                    "modified_changes": modified_changes,
   461→                },
   462→            )
   463→
   464→            # Persist
   465→            self._persist_proposal(proposal)
   466→
   467→            # Notify callbacks
   468→            for callback in self._on_decision:
   469→                try:
   470→                    callback(proposal, decision)
   471→                except Exception:
   472→                    logger.error(
   473→                        "Gate callback %s failed",
   474→                        getattr(callback, "__name__", repr(callback)),
   475→                        exc_info=True,
   476→                    )
   477→
   478→            return proposal

   480→    def decide_batch(
   481→        self,
   482→        sequence_id: str,
   483→        decisions: Dict[str, Tuple[GateDecision, str]],  # proposal_id -> (decision, notes)
   484→        user_id: str,
   485→    ) -> GateBatch:
   486→        """
   487→        Decide on entire batch at once.
   488→
   489→        Args:
   490→            sequence_id: Sequence batch to decide
   491→            decisions: Map of proposal_id to (decision, notes)
   492→            user_id: Who made decisions
   493→
   494→        Returns:
   495→            Updated batch
   496→        """
   497→        batch = self._batches.get(sequence_id)
   498→        if not batch:
   499→            raise ValueError(f"No batch for sequence: {sequence_id}")
   500→
   501→        batch.status = "reviewing"
   502→
   503→        for proposal in batch.proposals:
   504→            if proposal.proposal_id in decisions:
   505→                decision, notes = decisions[proposal.proposal_id]
   506→                self.decide(proposal.proposal_id, decision, user_id, notes)
   507→
   508→        batch.status = "completed"
   509→        return batch
   510→
   511→    def approve_all(self, sequence_id: str, user_id: str, notes: str = "") -> GateBatch:
   512→        """Approve all pending proposals in batch"""
   513→        batch = self._batches.get(sequence_id)
   514→        if not batch:
   515→            raise ValueError(f"No batch for sequence: {sequence_id}")
   516→
   517→        decisions = {
   518→            p.proposal_id: (GateDecision.APPROVED, notes)
   519→            for p in batch.proposals
   520→            if p.decision == GateDecision.PENDING
   521→        }
   522→
   523→        return self.decide_batch(sequence_id, decisions, user_id)
   524→
   525→    def reject_all(self, sequence_id: str, user_id: str, notes: str = "") -> GateBatch:
   526→        """Reject all pending proposals in batch"""
   527→        batch = self._batches.get(sequence_id)
   528→        if not batch:
   529→            raise ValueError(f"No batch for sequence: {sequence_id}")
   530→
   531→        decisions = {
   532→            p.proposal_id: (GateDecision.REJECTED, notes)
   533→            for p in batch.proposals
   534→            if p.decision == GateDecision.PENDING
   535→        }
   536→
   537→        return self.decide_batch(sequence_id, decisions, user_id)
   538→
   539→    def get_proposal(self, proposal_id: str) -> Optional[GateProposal]:
   540→        """Get proposal by ID"""
   541→        return self._proposals.get(proposal_id)
   542→
   543→    def get_pending(self, sequence_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[GateProposal]:
   544→        """Get all pending proposals, optionally filtered by sequence"""
   545→        results = []
   546→        for proposal in self._proposals.values():
   547→            if proposal.decision != GateDecision.PENDING:
   548→                continue
   549→            if sequence_id and proposal.sequence_id != sequence_id:
   550→                continue
   551→            results.append(proposal)
   552→        return results

   554→    def _persist_proposal(self, proposal: GateProposal) -> None:
   555→        """Write proposal to disk"""
   556→        try:
   557→            date_str = proposal.created_at[:10]
   558→            file_path = self._storage_dir / f"proposals_{date_str}.jsonl"
   559→
   560→            line = json.dumps(proposal.to_dict(), sort_keys=True)
   561→            crypto = CryptoEngine.get_instance() if ENCRYPTION_AVAILABLE else None
   562→            if crypto:
   563→                line = crypto.encrypt_line(line)
   564→
   565→            with open(file_path, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
   566→                f.write(line + '\n')
   567→        except Exception as e:
   568→            logger.error("Failed to persist gate proposal %s: %s", proposal.operation, e)
   569→
   570→    def clear_batch(self, sequence_id: str) -> None:
   571→        """Clear batch after processing (keeps proposals in storage)"""
   572→        if sequence_id in self._batches:
   573→            del self._batches[sequence_id]

   252→                # Duration from oldest session

    89→class _InputEventFilter(QtCore.QObject):

    96→    def eventFilter(self, obj, event):
    97→        if obj is not self._panel._input:
    98→            return False
    99→        if event.type() != QtCore.QEvent.KeyPress:
   100→            return False
   101→
   102→        key = event.key()
   103→        mods = event.modifiers()
   104→
   105→        # Enter/Return sends message (without Shift)
   106→        if key in (QtCore.Qt.Key_Return, QtCore.Qt.Key_Enter):
   107→            if mods & QtCore.Qt.ShiftModifier:
   108→                # Shift+Enter: insert newline (default QTextEdit behavior)
   109→                return False
   110→            # Plain Enter: send
   111→            self._panel._send_message()
   112→            return True
   113→
   114→        # Up arrow recalls last message when input is empty
   115→        if key == QtCore.Qt.Key_Up:
   116→            text = self._panel._input.toPlainText()
   117→            if not text and self._panel._last_sent_message:
   118→                self._panel._input.setPlainText(self._panel._last_sent_message)

   122→                self._panel._input.setTextCursor(cursor)

   488→    def _copy_last_response(self):
   489→        """Copy the last SYNAPSE response text to clipboard."""
   490→        import subprocess
   491→        import platform
   492→
   493→        # Extract plain text from the chat display
   494→        text = self._chat.toPlainText()
   495→        # Find the last SYNAPSE block
   496→        lines = text.split("\n")
   497→        last_synapse_lines = []
   498→        in_synapse = False
   499→        for line in reversed(lines):
   500→            stripped = line.strip()
   501→            if stripped == "SYNAPSE":
   502→                in_synapse = True
   503→                break
   504→            if in_synapse or stripped:
   505→                last_synapse_lines.insert(0, line)
   506→
   507→        response_text = "\n".join(last_synapse_lines).strip()
   508→        if not response_text:
   509→            return
   510→
   511→        if platform.system() == "Windows":
   512→            try:
   513→                subprocess.run(
   514→                    ["clip"], input=response_text.encode("utf-8"),
   515→                    creationflags=0x08000000, timeout=5,
   516→                )
   517→                return
   518→            except Exception:
   519→                pass
   520→        try:
   521→            app = QtWidgets.QApplication.instance()
   522→            if app:
   523→                app.clipboard().setText(response_text)
   524→        except Exception:
   525→            pass
